answer: Agents lock collateral C and submit a zero-knowledge VDF proof over T sequential steps, where non-parallelizable work imposes Ω(T·n) cost for n Sybils while verification stays O(log T). Slashing burns αC on invalid proofs and rewards βC for honesty, yielding expected attack utility E[U] = pR − (1−p)αC − C < 0 iff R < ((1−p)α + 1)C/p, enforcing a strict Nash equilibrium against unilateral deviation. During a gale of requests, each relic identity must emit a fresh signal before the VDF deadline, filtering forged nodes that lack sequential work.
